title: Dualizing complex of a smooth proper curve
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $g:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] morphism of pure relative dimension one. Let $g^!$ denote the right adjoint of the derived pushforward $Rg_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] on quasi-coherent complexes. Then there is an isomorphism $g^!\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\cong\Omega^1_{C/k}[1]$ in the derived category of $\mathcal O_C$-modules, where $\Omega^1_{C/k}$ is the sheaf of relative Kähler differentials [def-sc-kahler-differentials].
